product.title: Weldwood Landau Top & Trim 1145 High Heat Resistant Contact Cement
product.description: Weldwood 1145 High Solids HHR Contact adhesive is a sprayable contact adhesive specially developed to meet the reduced volatile and high coverage requirements of high volume plastic laminate fabricators. 1145 has excellent application properties and forms a high strength, high heat resistant bond that is resistant to water, many households chemicals and the effects of aging.
features: Water-resistant formula offering reliable protection against moisture and humidity
Ideal for automotive upholstery, foam and vinyl material.
Wide coverage with even spray application
Provides a strong and permanent bond on contact
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, making it a versatile choice for all projects.
Is VOC-Compliant and is designed for interior applications.
